## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` passes
- [ ] `pnpm lint` passes (zero warnings)
- [ ] `pnpm test` passes
- [ ] Crypto/vault changes include or update vitest tests
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes update `docs/security.md` / `docs/backup-format.md`
- [ ] No real card data anywhere in the diff (use test numbers)

## Description

What does this PR do, and why? Keep it focused — one logical change per PR.

## Related issues

Closes #...

## Screenshots (if UI changed)

Add screenshots with any card data blurred or masked.
